name: The Biker's Den
tagline: A converted farmhouse at the top of the old ghat road.
description:
A four-bedroom house set back from the Aamby Valley road, with a walled courtyard that takes eight bikes under cover and a caretaker who has been riding these roads for twenty years. The living room opens onto a lawn that drops away towards the valley, and the bonfire pit at the end of it is the reason most groups book a second night.

The house is old and has been renovated once. Floors are stone, ceilings are high, and it holds the cold well in December. Meals are cooked to order by the family that runs it.
priceNote: per night, up to 6 guests, weekdays
riderNote: Covered parking for eight bikes inside the gate, a wash-down tap by the shed, and basic tools including a foot pump and chain lube. The gate is manned until 2am.

nearbyRoutes.title: Old Khandala ghat descent
nearbyRoutes.note: Twelve minutes of switchbacks. Ride it before 8am.

nearbyRoutes.title: Pawna lake loop
nearbyRoutes.note: Flat, quiet, best at last light.

nearbyRoutes.title: Tamhini ghat
nearbyRoutes.note: A full day out and back. Fuel at Mulshi.

name: Coastal Rider Villa
tagline: Four hundred metres from Kihim beach, behind the coconut line.
description:
A single-storey villa on a plot of coconut and mango, five minutes' walk from the sand at Kihim. Three bedrooms, a long verandah, and a pool that gets the afternoon sun. The compound is gated and the parking is on gravel under a tin roof, which matters here — salt air takes chrome apart in a season.

The owners live in the house next door and cook on request. Breakfast can be served from six.
priceNote: per night, up to 4 guests, weekdays
riderNote: Covered gravel parking for six bikes and a freshwater tap for rinsing salt off before it sets. Early breakfast from 6am on request.

nearbyRoutes.title: Kihim to Kashid coast road
nearbyRoutes.note: The reason to come. Slow, and worth being slow on.

nearbyRoutes.title: Murud–Janjira run
nearbyRoutes.note: Fort at the end. Check ferry timings.

name: Riverside Camp
tagline: On the Ulhas, at the bottom of the Kondana climb.
description:
Six rooms in a low building beside the river, run by a family from the village. It is not a resort and does not pretend to be one — the rooms are plain, the food is excellent, and in July the water comes up close enough to hear all night.

The road in is unmetalled for the last kilometre and is not fun on a loaded bike after rain. Call ahead in the monsoon.
priceNote: per room per night, including breakfast
riderNote: Open parking inside the compound with a tarpaulin for six bikes. The host rides, and will tell you honestly whether the river crossing is passable.

nearbyRoutes.title: Karjat to Khopoli
nearbyRoutes.note: Short, fast, empty on a weekday morning.

nearbyRoutes.title: Matheran base road
nearbyRoutes.note: Climb stops at Dasturi. Bikes no further.

name: The Halt
tagline: A highway stay built for the four-in-the-morning start.
description: Twelve rooms directly off the old Mumbai–Pune highway, with a kitchen that opens at five and a forecourt lit all night. It exists for one purpose: to be the place you sleep when the ride is longer than one day. Nothing here is scenic. Everything here works.
priceNote: per room per night, two guests
riderNote: Lit, covered forecourt parking for twenty bikes with a night watchman. Fuel and a tyre shop are both within a kilometre.

name: Ridgeline House
tagline: Above the fog line, when there is one.
description: A two-bedroom stone house on the ridge past Lion's Point, positioned so that on the right morning the cloud sits below the terrace rather than around it. Small, quiet, and better suited to two or four people than to a large group.
priceNote: per night, up to 4 guests, two-night minimum
riderNote: Parking for four bikes under an extended roof. The last two kilometres are steep and get slick in the monsoon.

nearbyRoutes.title: Lion's Point to Bhushi
nearbyRoutes.note: Ride it at dawn or not at all — it is a car park by ten.

nearbyRoutes.title: Pawna lake loop
nearbyRoutes.note: Flat and quiet once past Kusgaon.

name: The Old Portuguese House
tagline: Interior Goa, an hour from any beach anyone has heard of.
description: A restored house in a village off the Ponda road — thick walls, a covered courtyard, and a garden that has been there considerably longer than the current owners. It is not near the sea, which is the point. The roads around it are empty, narrow and the best riding in the state.
riderNote: Courtyard parking behind a locked gate. There is a mechanic in the village who will look at anything with two wheels.

nearbyRoutes.title: Ponda to Chorla ghat
nearbyRoutes.note: The best road in Goa. Leave early.

name: The Lawn House
tagline: A staging post on the Mulshi side of the city.
description: A bungalow with a large lawn on the western edge of Pune, twenty minutes from the start of the Mulshi road. Booked mostly by groups the night before a ride and the night after one.
riderNote: Gated compound with covered parking for ten bikes and a wash-down corner. Breakfast from 5.30am for groups leaving early.

nearbyRoutes.title: Mulshi to Tamhini
nearbyRoutes.note: Reservoir on one side the whole way.

nearbyRoutes.title: Sinhagad climb
nearbyRoutes.note: Steep, narrow, closes to vehicles some days.

name: Sea Line
tagline: Full-service, and the only pool on this stretch of the coast.
description: Twenty-two rooms across two blocks behind Nagaon beach, with a restaurant, a pool and enough parking for a large group. The most conventional stay on this list, and the right answer when half the group did not want to camp.
priceNote: per room per night, two guests, weekdays

nearbyRoutes.title: Nagaon to Kashid
nearbyRoutes.note: Coast road, twenty minutes, no reason to hurry.

name: The Terrace
tagline: Panvel side, so the highway starts where you wake up.
description: A three-bedroom apartment on the Panvel side of the creek, chosen for its location rather than its view. Secure basement parking, a gate that opens at four, and the Mumbai–Goa highway ten minutes away.
riderNote: Basement parking with a shutter and a watchman. Gate opens at 4am on request — say so when you enquire.

nearbyRoutes.title: Panvel to Khopoli on the old road
nearbyRoutes.note: Clear before six, gridlocked after nine.
